pageDescription: MLI is resuming in-person classes mainly at Westwood campus. All ESL classes will resume in-person at Westwood campus from 7/06/21.
title: MLI Quarantine Policy
subtitle: MLI is resuming in-person classes mainly at Westwood campus. All ESL classes will resume in-person at Westwood campus from 7/06/21. Other programs available. Here is MLI's most updated quarantine policy based on LA county requirements.
While the Conversation program is offered at the Hollywood campus, all other Hollywood classes will remain online until further notice.
